_meta.source: In-game class-card screenshots and a Discord message (author shown as Derp[ARMY]) supplied by the site owner on 2026-11-05. Unlock conditions are community-reported and not verified by the original wiki.

reaper.desc: Huge damage, dodges most blows, steals life with every cut.
reaper.unlock: SOLO, no-hit, clear multiple dungeons of your same rank or above as a human (2-5)
reaper.rule: +15% damage with its own class's weapons (a hidden class: its origin class's too), +5% with those of a hidden class it leads to, -20% with another class's (the classless awakened's weapons and EX / SP: neutral); +10% HP with its armor, -10% with the others.

survivor.desc: Huge damage, dodges most blows, heals and boosts himself only.
survivor.unlock: Same as Reaper, just as a support
survivor.rule: +15% damage with its own class's weapons (a hidden class: its origin class's too), +5% with those of a hidden class it leads to, -20% with another class's (the classless awakened's weapons and EX / SP: neutral); +10% HP with its armor, -10% with the others.
